task.ques: Calculate the estimated time to sunburn for different skin types when exposed to the sun at 1:00 pm with SPF 1 in Brazil.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: At 1:00 pm (UTC−03) in Brazil with SPF 1, WolframAlpha estimates time to sunburn as follows: skin type I — 13 minutes; II — 17 minutes; III — 25 minutes; IV — 33 minutes; V — 48 minutes; VI — 3.5 hours.

The calculation uses October 27, 2026 (the task date) and WolframAlpha's location “Brazil,” with its UV forecast for the center of Brazil. The displayed input information confirms all skin types, Brazil, 1:00 pm UTC−03, and SPF 1. The “Typical time to sunburn” table supplies the estimates.

Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=sunburn&assumption=%7B%22FS%22%7D+-%3E+%7B%7B%22TimeToSunburn%22%2C+%22tb%22%7D%2C+%7B%22TimeToSunburn%22%2C+%22SPF%22%7D%7D&assumption=%7B%22F%22%2C+%22TimeToSunburn%22%2C+%22place%22%7D+-%3E%22Brazil%22&assumption=%7B%22FP%22%2C+%22TimeToSunburn%22%2C+%22SST%22%7D+-%3E+%22ST16%22&assumption=%7B%22C%22%2C+%22sunburn%22%7D+-%3E+%7B%22Formula%22%2C+%22dflt%22%7D&assumption=%7B%22F%22%2C+%22TimeToSunburn%22%2C+%22start%22%7D+-%3E%2227+Oct+2026+1%3A00+pm%22&assumption=%7B%22F%22%2C+%22TimeToSunburn%22%2C+%22SPF%22%7D+-%3E%221%22
